تستلبون (form VIII)
# تَسْتَلِبُونَ (tastalibūna) /tas.ta.li.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# تُسْتَلَبُونَ (tustalabūna) /tus.ta.la.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
